## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you started.

### Install ptsrv in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure ptsrv package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to ptsrv
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub [repository](https://github.com/owen-AR/ptsrv):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/owen-AR/ptsrv.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/owen-AR/ptsrv)

``` sh
$ conda install -c owen-AR ptsrv
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/ptsrv/)

``` sh
$ pip install ptsrv
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub [repository](https://github.com/owen-AR/ptsrv)’s [pages](https://owen-AR.github.io/ptsrv/). Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on [conda](https://anaconda.org/owen-AR/ptsrv) and [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/ptsrv/) respectively.
